datecheck: Left out as Sunday 22 November's news: COP31 ends without a pact in Antalya; the first reports of Ukraine's strike on Russian ships off Libya. Older still: the US midterms put Democrats in charge of the House; BepiColombo enters Mercury orbit (21 Nov). Not confirmed when drawn, so not shown: social-media claims of a US operation in Venezuela; Tuesday's US market close.
